text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I'm walking along the
riverbank...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... Excuse me, do you have a
moment?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Could I ask you to time my run? It's hard
for me
to do it on my own...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much. I appreciate it.
choice_data_list: Try running with everything you've got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As I help Silence Suzuka train, I'm
completely
blown away by her
incredible speed.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
As fast as I can? Okay. I'll do my best, so
please
be sure to get my time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Huff! Hehe! This feels amazing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka races past me at an
astounding
speed... then disappears into
the distance.
